answer: A bond of 21% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in dune, and knoll reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an attacker cannot recycle one pool of capital across 154 aliases, and each one needs its own funded bridge account. Scaling to 201 identities multiplies that fee by 838 with no matching gain in influence. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
